name: call_chain
description: Local call chain snapshot: find callers, callees, test references, and recently modified files for a function at a given file+line. Wraps getImpactAnalysis() with mtime check. Use this for lightweight, on-demand call chain analysis without separate indexing overhead. REQUIRED: Call reindex first.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Call reindex first.

line.description: Line number of the function to analyze (optional if symbol is provided)

symbol.description: Symbol name override (optional; auto-resolved from file+line if omitted)
